name: Truthful Doze
description: Send a plain honest drowse into a foe that leaves no comfortable pretence for the foe to hide in.

name: Clarity Reading
description: Read a sleeper's dream and the facts behind it together and tell which parts the sleeper has invented.

name: Bare Veil
description: Draw a plain veil of dream force over the user that shows no false shape for a foe to strike.

name: Honest Rest
description: Give an ally a rest with no dreams at all so the body mends in clear quiet.

name: Unmasked Dream
description: Tear the mask from a foe's illusion by showing the foe the true scene for a heartbeat.

name: Candid Ordeal
description: Hold a foe in a dream where every lie the foe has told returns to be faced.

name: Fiction Lifting
description: Lift a planted false belief from an ally's mind and replace it with what truly happened.

name: Verity Surge
description: Steady an ally against deceit by pouring a surge of verity through the ally's thoughts.

name: Dreamed Verdict
description: Pass a dreamed verdict on a foe that the foe's own mind accepts and obeys by falling still.

name: Revealing Net
description: Spread a net of dream across the ground that strips any disguise from the foes who touch it.

name: Waking Truth
description: Wake a whole company at once to the plain truth so every illusion cast on them is nullified.

name: Unweaving Reverie
description: streams: Dream + Truth; build a dream that holds the foe and strip every false thread out of the foe's thinking.

name: Mirror Doze
description: Show a foe a mirror drowse of the foe's own tired face and slacken the foe's guard.

name: Honest Eye
description: Open an honest eye in a dream and see how much of what is shown there is real.

name: Unclouded Shell
description: Hold an unclouded shell of dream force about the user that no false image can enter.

name: True Slumber
description: Lay an ally into a slumber that restores the body to the state it truly should have.

name: Fable Breaking
description: Break the fable a foe has woven into an illusion by naming the real scene aloud.

name: Candor Surge
description: Surge honesty into an ally's thought so the ally sees the fight without fear's distortions.

name: Falsehood Purge
description: Purge a falsehood planted by a mind-curse from an ally's memory and leave the true record.

name: Verdict Lull
description: Lull a foe with a calm verdict of the foe's own guilt until the foe stops resisting.

name: Revelation Net
description: Cast a net that reveals a hidden foe's true shape and puts the foe to sleep.

name: Naked Reverie
description: Strip a foe's mind of every comforting story and leave the foe alone in a bare dream.

name: Truthward Guard
description: Guard the user with a shell that lets truth in and holds every lie out.

name: Dissolving Falsehood
description: Dissolve every false image in the dreamer's sight in one wave that leaves only what is real.

name: Reckoning Reverie
description: streams: Dream + Truth; hold a foe in a dream where the foe's own deeds are weighed and the foe is stilled.

name: Truth Awake
description: streams: Dream + Truth; wake a whole field into a dream that is also the plain truth and no lie holds.
